where: app.html · excl, dmEmbarked from BOXES, labels
why: dmEmbarked now reads BOXES embarked (no regex at run time). The excl lever is right: ticking one box of a pick unticks the others with the same excl and the same giver (src), and unticking only flips that box. The labels are app-made from BOXES and the catalogue. But the exclusion lives only in the lever's apply. dmCalc does not enforce it: with both ticked in the state, Phaeron of the Stars and Phaeron of the Blades (The Silent King, Triarch Abilities) are both counted for Imotekh, with no 'counted by you' note (checked: on=true, over=false, extra='' for both). A state can hold both if it was saved before excl existed, or set by plan/ch or another code path.

why: The case ticks Phaeron of the Stars, then applies the Phaeron of the Blades lever, and checks Blades on and Stars off. That is right for the lever (372/372). It covers only the lever, not dmCalc with both ticked (see the app.html item); add a case for that with the fix: both on → the second has extra set and over true.

The new rules are closed and general: 'can only target' and 'contains a X model' restrictions; 'While … it can use one of the … below'; 'only select each … once per battle'; the selected enemy unit's keyword through Dv.tokens; the database's 'Once per turn' tag. excl comes from pickOf, which is the database's 'X: pick one' and X's own 'select one X' words. The embarked pattern now runs at build time and lands in BOXES (G1 SRC_KEYS allows it; G7 guards it). No unit or rule names are special-cased.
pickOf needs both the New Recruit grouping (ab.who 'X: pick one') and X's text 'select one X…', so it is not a reading. embarked is copied from the extractor's result. G7 is clean.
